title: ChatGPT makes designing images easy
title_candidates: What ChatGPT Images 2.5 can now build from a single line of text
How fast ChatGPT's new image tool now generates a full picture
ChatGPT just got image tools that make graphic design feel slow
Why ChatGPT images suddenly started looking this close to real photos
What OpenAI quietly changed about the way ChatGPT creates pictures
caption:
ChatGPT just upgraded its image generator to version 2.5. It's faster and the outputs are noticeably sharper than anything the tool produced before.

The biggest change is fidelity: faces, hands, and text inside images now hold up in ways earlier versions couldn't manage. Speed improved too, so results come back while the idea is still fresh in your head.

OpenAI is rolling this into the broader ChatGPT platform, making it the image layer for anyone building on top of it or just using it day to day.
